title: Seven mutual funds. How many different risks?
excerpt: More fund names can hide the same underlying bets. A closer look at portfolio overlap, the job of a SIP and the dates that should shape your investing decisions.
imageAlt: Illustrative generated scene of an Indian couple reviewing overlapping shapes and planning notes at home
seoDescription: Understand mutual fund overlap with a worked example, why SIPs do not remove market risk, and how goals and time horizons help you evaluate a portfolio.

title: Give your fixed deposits a calendar.
excerpt: School fees, repairs and future plans rarely arrive together. Explore how an FD ladder works—and what withdrawal terms, deposit insurance, tax and inflation change.
imageAlt: Illustrative generated scene of an Indian woman arranging three envelopes beside a planner at home
seoDescription: Explore FD laddering through a household example, with quarterly compounding, premature withdrawal terms, DICGC insurance and illustrative tax and inflation calculations.
